meta.name: consciousness-council
meta.description: Run a multi-perspective Mind Council deliberation on any question, decision, or creative challenge. Use this skill whenever the user wants diverse viewpoints, needs help making a tough decision, asks for a council/panel/board discussion, wants to explore a problem from multiple angles, requests devil's advocate analysis, or says things like "what would different experts think about this", "help me think through this from all sides", "council mode", "mind council", or "deliberate on this". Also trigger when the user faces a dilemma, trade-off, or complex choice with no obvious answer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从多角度探讨任何问题，做出更明智的决策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常面临复杂问题需要多方观点
copy.tagline_en: Deliberate any question from multiple perspectives for better decisions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often face complex decisions and want diverse viewpoints

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把你的问题交给一个由多个思维原型组成的“议会”。每个原型从自己的视角发言并互相反驳,最后综合成一份报告,包含共识、核心矛盾、盲点、建议路径和置信度。
howto.when: 当你提到“council mode”“mind council”等关键词,或要求多角度讨论、魔鬼代言人分析,或面临两难抉择时触发。

say.text: 开个议会,帮我权衡要不要辞职创业。
say.note: Claude 会召集多个思维原型进行辩论并给出综合建议。

say.text: 用快速议会模式分析这个方案的风险。
say.note: 议会将用3名成员、较短回应给出结果。

say.text: 来个深度议会,针对这个道德困境给出报告。
say.note: 议会将用6名成员、扩展推理并输出完整综合。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude turns your question over to a 'council' of multiple thinking archetypes. Each archetype speaks from its own perspective and disagrees with others, then a synthesis is produced with convergence points, core tension, blind spot, recommended path, and confidence level.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'council mode' or 'mind council', ask for multi-perspective discussion or devil's advocate analysis, or face a dilemma.

say_en.text: Hold a council to help me weigh quitting my job to start a company.
say_en.note: Claude will summon multiple archetypes to debate and give a synthesis.

say_en.text: Use quick council mode to analyze this plan's risks.
say_en.note: A 3-member council with shorter replies will run.

say_en.text: Run a deep council on this moral dilemma and report.
say_en.note: A 6-member council with extended reasoning will produce a full synthesis.
